goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, compose a private memo, and access the application settings menu.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the main dashboard, type 'Personal reminder for the weekend.' into the text input area labeled 'Any thoughts...', click the 'Private' button to set visibility, and then click the 'Save' button.
Click the settings icon (gear symbol) located in the left-hand sidebar to open the settings menu.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and redirected to the main dashboard after signing up.
The memo 'Personal reminder for the weekend.' appears in the feed with a timestamp of 'now' and is marked as private.
The settings menu or configuration options are visible on the screen after clicking the settings icon.
No error messages are displayed during account creation or memo saving.
